thread:
evan_support: FYI — multiple Dedicated customers hitting placement failures + 503s in us-west-2 for the last 10m. Getting a couple of high-sev escalations. ticket #INC-7832 :angry:
lucy_ops: Which error codes are they seeing? 503/429/401? any auth or billing noise?
evans_support: Mostly 503 + placement deny messages in logs. One report of a 429 burst for retries. No auth/billing errors in the customer logs we have so far.
olivia_cs: Customer 'BlueTower' reported 30% error rate on reserved pool requests starting ~10:12 PDT. They attached this snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T17:12:34Z ERROR placement: deny "no-capacity" region=us-west-2 pool=dedicated-usw2-rt
2026-03-17T17:12:34Z WARN api: 503 gateway: model=redwood-jumbo tenant=bt-corp request_id=xyz
```
lucy_ops: :eyes: autoscale metrics show reservation failures + much higher scheduling latency in us-west-2 AZ-a. Could be node evictions hitting our reservation pipeline.
raj_sre: Poking the allocator, seeing rapid capacity churn. Some hosts marked Draining by kube after OOM events. Running `kubectl get pods -n dedicated-usw2 -o wide | grep Scheduling` to confirm.
max_eng: I just saw autoscale-bot note: `autoscale-bot: scale_down_blocked:recent_evictions=true` — maybe backoff prevented immediate replacement?
autoscale-bot: scale_event: scale_down_blocked=true; candidate_replacements=0; recent_evictions=3; cooldown_until=2026-03-17T17:18:00Z
lucy_ops: If replacement candidate count is 0, placement will deny while we wait for new nodes. Can we hot-add capacity from spare pool or fallback to west-1?
capacity-lead: We have a small hot spare in na-central but it's pinned to other commitments. I can free up one node if we need immediate relief. Question: do we want automated cross-region failover for Dedicated reservations? That's risky for data locality.
evan_support: Customers are complaining about latency and errors; BlueTower is pushing for immediate mitigation. They explicitly require us-west. They said failover would break SLOs for them.
raj_sre: Short-term plan: (1) patch scheduler to temporarily relax AZ affinity for pending reservations in this pool (2) force-provision one spare node into us-west-2 from na-central (3) update rate-limiter to give soft priority to active reserved tenants.
max_eng: On (1) — we can flip the AZ-affinity flag for pool=dedicated-usw2-rt for 10 minutes. Patch is trivial: set `affinity_tolerance=zone` -> `affinity_tolerance=region`. I'll push a canary change to staging then prod if green.
olivia_cs: I'll message BlueTower that we're taking immediate steps to mitigate; they'll want ETA. Can we give 20-30m?
lucy_ops: ETA: provisioning node from na-central -> us-west transfer + spin-up ~ 12-18m if hardware reservation accepted. AZ-affinity patch + scheduler restart should be under 5m.
evan_support: Please post exact commands and logs here for audit. Also list rollback steps.
max_eng: Commands I'll run (canary first):
```
# staging canary
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/pools/dedicated-usw2-rt/config" -d '{"affinity_tolerance":"region"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
# confirm pending placements are requeued
curl "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/placements?pool=dedicated-usw2-rt&state=pending" | jq '.[] | {id, status, region}'
```
Rollback is flipping `affinity_tolerance` back to `zone`.
raj_sre: I'll handle the node transfer ticket with infra and track the host bootstrap logs. If the patch causes unexpected scheduling to west-1, we can revert within 2m.
olivia_cs: BlueTower updated the ticket — they've paused new requests and asked for a 15m window to decide on failover.
capacity-lead: I've approved freeing 1 node; infra says it's draining now from na-central and will be ready to ship in ~10m.
lucy_ops: Note: we should watch for noisy-tenant behavior — earlier today we had a tenant blasting long context workloads in the same pool which could be causing KV cache pressure and OOM. If noisy-tenant continues, even added nodes will thrash.
max_eng: Good call. I'll enable per-tenant token rate cap for the pool as a safety: `tenant_rate_limit=50rps` for unverified tenants. Non-breaking change and reversible.
olivia_cs: BlueTower replied: thanks, please proceed with regional patch + node add. They asked that we keep them in the loop and share post-mortem.
raj_sre: Patch applied to prod at 17:20Z, scheduler re-queued pending placements. Metrics: pending-reservations dropped from 120 -> 18 in 90s.
lucy_ops: New node bootstrap logs show successful join at 17:29Z, kube node ready, pods scheduled. Placement deny logs tailing off.
evans_support: Customer reports error rate down to 3% and requests succeeded for previously failed jobs. BlueTower confirms recovery and is on call for validation.
capacity-lead: I'll open a follow-up to evaluate resizing hot-spare pool and revisit autoscale backoff thresholds to prevent candidate count=0.
max_eng: Action items: 
- max_eng: revert temporary tenant_rate_limit if not needed after 60m
- raj_sre: track OOM cause and noisy-tenant identification (root cause)
- capacity-lead: propose hot-spare sizing by EOD
- lucy_ops: draft post-mortem and customer timeline

If anything regresses, ping here and I'll escalate to exec on-call. :thumbsup:
